targets.title: Octopocus: A dynamic guide for learning gesture-based command sets
targets.evidence_quote: The technique was evaluated in a near replication of Bau and Mackay’s study protocol using a VR crib-sheet as a baseline.
targets.outcome_quote: Our study replication also enables a direct comparison with Bau and Mackay’s OctoPocus in 2D. Our results are largely consistent, except Bau and Mackay found crib-sheet and OctoPocus to be comparable in terms of execution speed. In addition, while Bau and Mackay showed that OctoPocus improves gesture recall and incidental learning of non-practised gestures in 2D, we did not find evidence that these benefits translate to VR.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The paper explicitly compares its new sample against Bau and Mackay: accuracy and training trends agree, whereas timing, recall and incidental-learning benefits differ. Overall viability of the new interface is not an overall verdict confirming every original result. Delamare et al. supply a design recommendation and contextual comparisons rather than the protocol/finding this experiment re-tests.
